description: This file defines the 'tlRight' class which represents a security right/permission within the TestLink project. The class includes methods for database initialization, reading, copying, and string representation of rights, and handles database interactions for rights objects.

classes.name: tlRight
classes.description: Represents a security right with database persistence, readable as string, and copy capabilities within the TestLink system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a tlRight object, optionally with a database handle, enabling caching.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets the object's properties to a clean state.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the right as string representation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets the database ID and name of the right.

methods.name: copyFromCache
methods.description: Copies data from another tlRight object into this one.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Reads the right object from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: readFromDBRow
methods.description: Populates the object from a database row.

methods.name: getReadFromDBQuery
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to read rights from the database based on IDs.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Static method to fetch a right by its database ID.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Static method to fetch multiple rights by their database IDs.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all rights matching an optional where clause.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Persists the right object to the database (not implemented).

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the right object from the database (not implemented).
